newsitem.title: USA: Springs Industries sees lower Q4, yr net.
newsitem.headline: Springs Industries sees lower Q4, yr net.

text.p: Springs Industries Inc said on Tuesday that it expects its results for the fourth quarter and full year 1996 would be lower than expectations and those of the prior year.
Springs Industries said the year results are expected to be higher than 1995, when a gain is included from the sale of its Clark-Schwebel subsidiary.
Excluding the gain, 1996 results, however, are expected to be 15 percent below the $3.71 a share reported last year, Springs Industries said.
Income from continuing businesses are expected to top year ago levels, but will not overcome the absence of Clark-Schwebel, the company said.
